stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रियव्रतस्य प्रियपुत्रभूता-
-दाग्नीध्रराजादुदितो हि नाभिः ।
त्वां दृष्टवानिष्टदमिष्टिमध्ये
तवैव तुष्ट्यै कृतयज्ञकर्मा ॥ २०-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Priyavrata's elder son was Aagnidhara. He had a son called Naabhi. King Nabhi was not having children for a long time. Therefore, he performed yagna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
priyavratasya priyaputrabhūtā-
-dāgnīdhrarājādudito hi nābhiḥ |
tvāṃ dṛṣṭavāniṣṭadamiṣṭimadhye
tavaiva tuṣṭyai kṛtayajñakarmā || 20-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अभिष्टुतस्तत्र मुनीश्वरैस्त्वं
राज्ञः स्वतुल्यं सुतमर्थ्यमानः ।
स्वयं जनिष्येऽहमिति ब्रुवाण-
-स्तिरोदधा बर्हिषि विश्वमूर्ते ॥ २०-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord appeared in the sacrificial fire and granted a boon that Lord himself will be born as their child to the couple.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
abhiṣṭutastatra munīśvaraistvaṃ
rājñaḥ svatulyaṃ sutamarthyamānaḥ |
svayaṃ janiṣye’hamiti bruvāṇa-
-stirodadhā barhiṣi viśvamūrte || 20-2 ||

stanzas.commentary_en: Then Lord was born with the name Rishabha to Merudevi the wife of Naabhi. The Lord delighted everyone with sublime virtues and glory not commonly seen in the world.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वयि त्रिलोकीभृति राज्यभारं
निधाय नाभिः सह मेरुदेव्या ।
तपोवनं प्राप्य भवन्निषेवी
गतः किलानन्दपदं पदं ते ॥ २०-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Naabhi entrusted the administration of the kingdom to Lord Rishabha, who are the ruler of the three worlds and went away to the forest with his wife Merudevi to lead a devoted life. Worshipping The Lord there, he attained the state of Supreme Bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvayi trilokībhṛti rājyabhāraṃ
nidhāya nābhiḥ saha merudevyā |
tapovanaṃ prāpya bhavanniṣevī
gataḥ kilānandapadaṃ padaṃ te || 20-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इन्द्रस्त्वदुत्कर्षकृतादमर्षा-
-द्ववर्ष नास्मिन्नजनाभवर्षे ।
यदा तदा त्वं निजयोगशक्त्या
स्ववर्षमेनद्व्यदधाः सुवर्षम् ॥ २०-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Owing to jealousy at the prosperity of the world generated by Rishabha's greatness, Indra withheld rain from the continent Ajanaabha. Thereupon Rishabha with his yogic power brought enough rain on to the continent.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
indrastvadutkarṣakṛtādamarṣā-
-dvavarṣa nāsminnajanābhavarṣe |
yadā tadā tvaṃ nijayogaśaktyā
svavarṣamenadvyadadhāḥ suvarṣam || 20-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जितेन्द्रदत्तां कमनीं जयन्ती-
-मथोद्वहन्नात्मरताशयोऽपि ।
अजीजनत् तत्र शतं तनूजा-
-नेषां क्षितीशो भरतोऽग्रजन्मा ॥ २०-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Rishabha won over Indra. Thereby, Indra bestowed his beautiful daughter Jayanti on the Lord as Lord’s wife. Rishaba took the hand of his daughter Jayanthi and they had one hundred sons, eldest of them was Bharatha.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jitendradattāṃ kamanīṃ jayantī-
-mathodvahannātmaratāśayo’pi |
ajījanat tatra śataṃ tanūjā-
-neṣāṃ kṣitīśo bharato’grajanmā || 20-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नवाभवन् योगिवरा नवान्ये
त्वपालयन् भारतवर्षखण्डान् ।
सैका त्वशीतिस्तव शेषपुत्रा-
-स्तपोबलाद्भूसुरभूयमीयुः ॥ २०-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Among hundred, Bharatha became the next king of Bharathavarsha. Nine of the other sons became yogis; another nine ruled over various other regions, remaining eighty one became Brahmins by the power of their spiritual actions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
navābhavan yogivarā navānye
tvapālayan bhāratavarṣakhaṇḍān |
saikā tvaśītistava śeṣaputrā-
-stapobalādbhūsurabhūyamīyuḥ || 20-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
उक्त्वा सुतेभ्योऽथ मुनीन्द्रमध्ये
विरक्तिभक्त्यन्वितमुक्तिमार्गम् ।
स्वयं गतः पारमहंस्यवृत्ति-
-मधा जडोन्मत्तपिशाचचर्याम् ॥ २०-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rishaba advised all his sons and other yogis, the path of salvation through renouncing desires and indulging in deep devotion to Lord.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
uktvā sutebhyo’tha munīndramadhye
viraktibhaktyanvitamuktimārgam |
svayaṃ gataḥ pāramahaṃsyavṛtti-
-madhā jaḍonmattapiśācacaryām || 20-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
परात्मभूतोऽपि परोपदेशं
कुर्वन् भवान् सर्वनिरस्यमानः ।
विकारहीनो विचचार कृत्स्नां
महीमहीनात्मरसाभिलीनः ॥ २०-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Rishabha moved to forest and attained complete identity with the Brahman & continued to impart knowledge to others. Lord Rishabha was free from attachment and wandered all over the earth completely absorbed in the bliss of the Supreme self.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
parātmabhūto’pi paropadeśaṃ
kurvan bhavān sarvanirasyamānaḥ |
vikārahīno vicacāra kṛtsnāṃ
mahīmahīnātmarasābhilīnaḥ || 20-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
शयुव्रतं गोमृगकाकचर्यां
चिरं चरन्नाप्य परं स्वरूपम् ।
दवाहृताङ्गः कुटकाचले त्वं
तापान्ममापाकुरु वातनाथ ॥ २०-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: He wandered all through the earth, observing the life of python, cow, deer, crow, advising spiritual values to people and devotion to supreme Lord as means of salvation. Finally Rishaba Deva merged with Lord, by giving his body to a forest fire in the Coorg mountains, thus completing his spiritual journey in Earth.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śayuvrataṃ gomṛgakākacaryāṃ
ciraṃ carannāpya paraṃ svarūpam |
davāhṛtāṅgaḥ kuṭakācale tvaṃ
tāpānmamāpākuru vātanātha || 20-10 ||
